|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Corporal Rushing (V)]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A same-words slip on a Players Committee release sheet that reprints a card image is part of that card image's version, not a version of its own (Bill, 17 November 2026).
